body.x: Mayor Oh Se-hoon visited the opening ceremony of the world's largest electronics and IT exhibition, 'CES 2024,' held at 10 a.m. on January 9th in Las Vegas, USA.

On-site, he took the lead in networking with global companies, startups, governments, IT experts, and others gathered from around the world, promoting Seoul's smart city competitiveness and showcasing Seoul companies on the global stage.

CES is the world's largest ICT exhibition, held annually in Las Vegas and organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). It serves as a business platform for global companies leading IT industry trends and startups with cutting-edge technologies, connecting them with investors, tech talent, and customers worldwide.

From January 9th (Tuesday) to January 12th (Friday), Seoul operates the largest-ever 'Seoul Pavilion' at CES 2024. Since participating in CES for the first time in 2020 with 20 companies, Seoul has been running the 'Seoul Pavilion' to attract investment and support sales for innovative companies in Seoul. As the size of participating companies and the number of award-winning innovation companies increase, Seoul plans to expand its role as a civic-led startup ecosystem, allowing innovative startups to be recognized by investors.

body.cap: Mayor Oh Se-hoon toured the pavilion at 'CES 2024' on January 9th, 10 a.m. local time in Las Vegas. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Participating in this year's CES are 13 collaborating institutions, including the Seoul Business Agency, Seoul Biohub, Seoul AI Hub, Gwanak-gu, Korea University, Yonsei University, Sogang University, Hanyang University, Chung-Ang University, Konkuk University, Kookmin University, and Kyung Hee University.

At 'Seoul Pavilion' in CES 2024, collaboration with 13 institutions will showcase innovative technologies and products from 81 startups based in Seoul to global investors. This is the largest 'Seoul Pavilion' at CES so far.

Among the 81 participating companies in 'Seoul Pavilion,' 18 received innovation awards at CES 2024. Two companies, TopTable (personalized nutrition) and Loadsystem (mobile passport), received the highest innovation award, given to only 1% of participating companies.

body.cap: Mayor Oh Se-hoon gave an opening speech to start the first day of the Seoul Pavilion.

body.x: The CES Innovation Awards, established in 1976, are awarded by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) for innovative products and technologies that demonstrate technical, aesthetic, and visionary excellence. The CES 2024 selected 36 Best of Innovation Awards and 522 Innovation Awards in 29 categories.

On January 9th (Thursday) at 11 a.m. local time, Mayor Oh Se-hoon attended the opening ceremony of 'Seoul Pavilion' with about 100 people, including CTA President Gary Shapiro and representatives of participating companies. During the 'Seoul Pavilion tour,' Mayor Oh promised to provide comprehensive support for the technology and services of innovative startups to enter the overseas market.

body.cap: Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Kim Hyun-woo (CEO of Seoul Business Agency), Gary Shapiro (CTA President), and other guests took a commemorative photo at the 'CES 2024' opening ceremony. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The opening ceremony, which began with a video of Seoul citizens cheering for Seoul startups, included the 'Seoul Startup Innovation Tree Lighting Ceremony,' symbolizing the growth of startup seeds planted by Seoul into global companies.

This year, 'Seoul Pavilion' will exhibit innovative technologies and products from 81 companies in the fields of healthcare (31), AI (25), manufacturing (11), mobility (7), ESG (4), and quantum (3). In addition, pitching and networking programs targeting global investors and buyers will be operated.

During the luncheon meeting with representatives of innovation award-winning companies, Mayor Oh encouraged companies that achieved good results with innovative technologies and products in the face of the global investment downturn. He promised to expand support at the city level to eliminate regulatory barriers that break the entrepreneurial spirit in new industries and technologies. Regarding issues the central government needs to address, Mayor Oh pledged to convey the voices of startups actively.

The Consumer Technology Association (CTA) hosts CES, the world's largest IT exhibition held annually in Las Vegas, USA, allowing visitors to grasp global trends in the home appliance industry at a glance. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been reporting CES news worldwide since 2006 and selecting the best innovative products, companies, and technologies through 'BEST OF CES' and 'BEST OF MADE IN KOREA.' Additionally, through 'AVING LIVE,' they deliver real-time CES issues.
